keySentence: She questioned everything because Wonderland had no ordinary rules.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: There was a trial in Wonderland. The Queen wanted to punish first. Alice said that was not fair. She questioned everything because Wonderland had no ordinary rules.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice attended a trial where the Knave was accused of stealing. The Queen demanded a verdict before hearing any evidence at all. Alice stood up and said that was completely wrong and unfair. She questioned everything because Wonderland had no ordinary rules. You cannot punish someone without proof no matter who you are. Alice showed that asking questions is the bravest thing we can do.
facts.Word cards: ordinary = 보통의 / questioned = 의문을 가졌다 / no rules = 규칙 없음 / because = 왜냐하면
